source.body:
<!-- Please follow the template below. Skip the questions that are not relevant to you. -->

## Describe the problem/error/question
When chatting with the AI Assistant about a workflow, whenever a confirmation card appears (i.e. “Allow access to this website?”) any text drafted in the text box is deleted. This is annoying because I may be typing a long instruction while the Assistant is working and then an unexpected confirmation appears and my previous work is gone.

## What is the error message (if any)?
None
